title: How Jensen Huang scandal makes Congress a bigger risk to U.S.-China relations
summary_full: Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a woman suspected by the U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy has spurred efforts seeking stricter curbs on tech exports to Beijing.
